title: Review the draft income statement — Lumen Corp.
instructions: A staff accountant drafted Lumen Corp.'s 2025 income statement. Compare it with the trial balance data. Tick each amount that is wrong and enter the correct amount, then answer the classification questions. Enter the loss from discontinued operations as a positive number.

exhibits.title: Trial balance data — 2025
exhibits.content:
| Item | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Sales revenue | 2,400,000 |
| Cost of goods sold, before inventory write-down | 1,450,000 |
| Write-down of inventory to net realizable value (not yet in the draft) | 30,000 |
| Selling and administrative expenses | 480,000 |
| Operating loss of the Harbor division, sold in 2025 (a strategic shift with a major effect on operations) | 40,000 |
| Unrealized holding gain on available-for-sale debt securities | 25,000 |

Income tax rate: 21% on all items.

exhibits.title: Draft income statement
exhibits.content:
| Line | Amount |
|---|---:|
| Sales revenue | 2,400,000 |
| Cost of goods sold | (1,450,000) |
| Operating expenses (includes the Harbor division loss) | (520,000) |
| Unrealized gain on AFS debt securities | 25,000 |
| Income before tax | 455,000 |
| Income tax expense | (95,550) |
| **Net income** | **359,450** |

rows.label: Sales revenue
rows.explanation: Agrees with the trial balance. **No error.**

rows.label: Cost of goods sold
rows.explanation: The 30,000 write-down of inventory to net realizable value is part of continuing operations, usually in cost of goods sold: **1,480,000**.

rows.label: Operating expenses
rows.explanation: The preparer included the 40,000 discontinued-segment loss; operating expenses are **480,000**.

rows.label: Other income — unrealized holding gain on AFS debt securities
rows.explanation: Unrealized gains on AFS debt securities go to **OCI**, not net income: **0**.

rows.label: Income from continuing operations before tax
Income tax expense on continuing operations
Loss from discontinued operations, net of tax

parts.prompt: Where should each item be reported?

rows.label: The Harbor division operating loss
rows.explanation: A disposed component that is a strategic shift with a major effect is reported in **discontinued operations, net of tax**.

rows.label: The unrealized holding gain on AFS debt securities
rows.explanation: AFS debt securities' unrealized gains go to **OCI**.

rows.label: The inventory write-down to NRV
rows.explanation: Write-downs of inventory are a normal **continuing operations** expense.
